thread:
zara: Heads-up — planning to push frontend v1.12.0 to prod today at 17:30 UTC. Who can own smoke checks + rollback readiness?
kevin: I can take smoke. Will be on call from 17:15–18:00 UTC.
ciara: I’ll run the CDN edge priming + asset-ttl verification. Please remind me which routes to invalidate.
mahesh: I’ll be on standby for rollback (tag: v1.11.9). If anything spikes >2% error rate we roll back.
olivia: Quick note — analytics events changed, expect a rollout flag toggle. I’ll watch event counts.
deploy-bot: deploy plan created: frontend:v1.12.0 -> Canary 17:30 UTC (5% traffic) -> 30m ramp -> 100%. Approvals: zara, kevin.
ciara: CDN plan: invalidate /static/*hash*.js and /static/*hash*.css on the edge-cdn, then warm popular edges (screenshot smoke). Will run TTL sweep for old assets.
zara: Please also run the screenshot smoke against /console and /dashboard to catch css regressions. Use the headless smoke job: `./tools/smoke.sh --urls /console /dashboard --screenshots`
kevin: Smoke checklist I’ll follow: 1) health ping 2) login 3) core flows smoke (create temp workspace) 4) api latency check 5) screenshots.
kevin: health ping: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://console.redwood.ai/_health` should return 200.
ciara: After CDN invalidation I’ll run `curl -I` on two edge IPs to confirm new asset etags. Example: `curl -I https://edge-1.redwood.ai/static/app-abc123.js`
mahesh: Rollback plan: 1) Pause ramp, 2) Revert service tag to v1.11.9, 3) Purge new assets if needed, 4) Notify customers. I’ll prepare the revert PR now.
zara: Who has rights to trigger full purge? ciara, do you need help from infra?
ciara: I have purge rights for the edge-cdn but need infra to raise invalidation speed if we hit rate limits. @kevin pls ping infra if >500 objects.
kevin: noted. infra ping if >500 objects or >3s purge job latency.
olivia: Monitoring: I’ll watch two dashboards — frontend errors (5xx rate), auth latency, and analytics-event ingestion. If any baseline deviation >10% we pause.
deploy-bot: Canary will emit canary metrics to /metrics/canary; SRE alerting enabled for 5xx spike and p95 tail.
ciara: Small test before canary: will deploy a canary build to staging-edge and run screenshot diff. Doing that at 17:00 UTC.
zara: Perfect. Timeline: 17:00 staging edge smoke; 17:15 handoff to kevin/ciara; 17:30 canary start; 18:00 ramp decision.
kevin: Ack. I’ll post quick results in this thread after smoke.
mahesh: I’ll be ready to cut traffic if rollback needed. Kept manual step in the pipeline for immediate revert.
ciara: One more: asset metadata header must include `x-asset-version: v1.12.0`. I’ll verify during edge checks.
zara: Thanks — if anyone sees UI flashes or missing fonts during screenshots, call rollback. :warning:
kevin: Smoke started — health ping 200, login flow ok, creating workspace succeeded. Next: screenshots.
kevin: Screenshots done — small visual shift on /dashboard charts (minor CSS), not blocking. I’m green to proceed to canary.
zara: Proceeding to canary now. Will update thread when ramp starts.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp initiated at 17:31:12 UTC — 5% traffic.
olivia: Watching analytics — event counts normal so far.
ciara: CDN invalidation completed; new assets show `x-asset-version: v1.12.0` on edge-2 and edge-5.
kevin: Monitoring 10m: p50 latency stable, errors flat. No rollback.
zara: Decision at 18:00 — looks safe to continue to full rollout unless objections.
mahesh: No objections. Standby until 18:05 then I’ll approve full.
zara: Full rollout starting 18:02.
deploy-bot: Full rollout started at 18:02:03 UTC -> 100% planned.
kevin: Post-rollout smoke: health 200, login ok, create workspace ok. Visuals good.
olivia: Analytics events steady, ingestion latency ok.
ciara: Edge checks green. No orphaned old asset ETAGs.
zara: Awesome. Thanks all for quick turnaround. I’ll close this thread after one hour of stable metrics.
kevin: Thanks — will mark in release notes and tag the deploy ticket. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Release: frontend v1.12.0 marked deployed at 18:04:10 UTC.
zara: Closing thread — if anything pops up DM me and ping this channel.
